title: pmx session calendar v1
description: One file data/datasets/<name>/calendars/<calendar_id>.json: the dated trading sessions of one venue for the dataset's window, generated by pmx.data.sessions (D1, ruling R174) from the exchange's rules and holidays and sealed with the dataset (CONTRACTS_V2 17.2, ruling R149). A bar of a ContinuousInstrument exists iff its interval intersects one of these sessions; a bar outside every session is a load error; a binary is never checked against a calendar (ruling R185). The record is dated and not a weekly template because daylight saving moves a venue's UTC hours twice a year. The continuous calendar is reserved: the loader synthesises it as one session [0, INT63_MAX) and refuses a file carrying that id (ruling R185). The window must cover every bar of every instrument naming the calendar. Cross-item rules (sorted, non-overlapping, inside the window, open before close) are asserted by tests/test_contract_schemas.py and by the loader.

calendar_id.description: A lowercase slug; continuous is reserved and never a file (ruling R185).

holidays.description: Informative: the closed weekdays the generator knew about. The sessions list is the normative object.
